english.title: Operator or pilot of helicopter on which cockpit voice or flight data recorder not always in use
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were the

(A)_[operator]_
(B)_[pilot in command]_

of a helicopter, namely **(..SPECIFY AIRCRAFT..), on a flight, namely **(..SPECIFY FLIGHT..), on which a

(C)_[cockpit voice]_
(D)_[flight data]_
(E)_[combined cockpit voice recorder and flight data]_

recorder was required by paragraph 4(13) of Part 1 of Schedule 6 to the Air Navigation Order 2016 to be carried, when the recorder was not always in use from the time the rotors first turned for the purpose of taking off until the rotors were next stopped
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 231(2) and 265(6) of the Air Navigation Order 2016
